title: Certified Baker
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Requirements for the Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate attributes of a professional baker including: sense of urgency, organization, foundational skills techniques, ingredient selection, appropriate care of commercial equipment, leadership, teamwork, interpersonal skills, preparing, serving and cleaning.
Identify and administer rigorous food safety and sanitation practices.
Demonstrate proficiency in basic ingredient conversions, food costing and yield management practices.

blocks.name: Requirements for the Certificate of Achievement

notes: The catalog prints codes with leading zeros (HOSP 003, HOSP 014, HOSP 015, HOSP 060); they are treated as the closed-list courses HOSP 3, HOSP 14, HOSP 15 and HOSP 60, so catalog_addition is false.

The page also has a generic 'General Education Requirements for the Associate in Science Degree' section (PCC Local Gen Ed / Cal-GETC). It does not apply to this certificate, so ge_pattern and degree_total stay null.
The program outcomes are printed for the program page as a whole; this certificate is the only award on the page, so they are recorded for it.

Careers lists the job titles named in the description. The hospitality industries named after them (restaurants, hospitals, retail, catering, etc.) are industries, not careers, and are left out; a reviewer may want to check this choice.
The catalog text prints 'bakers,,' with a double comma.
